voices.name: l00
voices.text: When you sit to meditate, <#0.2#> do your thoughts get louder?
voices.caption: When you sit to meditate, do your thoughts get louder?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: You're not bad at it. <#0.3#> The order is just wrong.
voices.caption: You're not bad at it. The order is just wrong.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: At first, don't sit. <#0.2#> Move first.
voices.caption: At first, don't sit. Move first.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Hands, shoulders, whole body. <#0.2#> Shake it out for one minute.
voices.caption: Hands, shoulders, whole body. Shake it out for one minute.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Then the moment you stop, <#0.3#> a quiet gap opens.
voices.caption: Then the moment you stop, a quiet gap opens.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: In that gap, <#0.2#> picture one scene you want.
voices.caption: In that gap, picture one scene you want.
